rows.grounds: Instrumental plural feminine of compound deva-gandharva-nārī (deva+gandharva+nārī, members of bahuvrīhi/tatpuruṣa compound); gloss: 'by-gods-and-gandharva-women'.
Locative singular neuter of compound gāyatrī-ādi-vibhūṣita (gāyatrī+ādi+vibhūṣita, 'adorned with singing etc.'); case/gender inferred from -e ending, context AMBIGUOUS (could also be loc.sg.m.).
